answer: Require each agent identity to hold a live, non-transferable compute lease, verified like a ledge that must be stood on, not merely claimed. At unpredictable moments the network sends a cipher challenge that only the true leaseholder can solve within seconds using its rented machine. A single server cannot answer for thousands of identities at once, so every fake identity needs its own paid lease; the cost scales linearly with the number of fakes, while an honest agent keeps one small ember of rented capacity burning and passes with ease.
